method: static frozen public task receipts + frozen source inspection; no simulator/model

definitions.qualified_failure: Public move_to error whose full receipt matches endpoint-conflict grammar and actor; finite exact XYZ; next public status confirms unchanged XYZ before another same-actor action.
definitions.cross_actor_later_failure_event: A qualified failure with an earlier qualified failure in the same plan/scene/epoch at exact XYZ by a different actor. Count each later request once, irrespective of number of sources.
definitions.group: One exact XYZ in a plan/scene/epoch with qualified failures by at least two actors.
definitions.geometry_change: Same public obstacle ID later observed with different type/position/radius/vertices/width/length/height. Empty nearby lists or absent names do not retract an obstacle.
definitions.counterevidence: Later successful move to exact XYZ or public drone position at exact XYZ; scanned separately from named obstacle observations/changes.
